_comment: LEADCF -> CRM field map, established EMPIRICALLY on 2026-08-15 by submitting one probe lead per index and reading the result back via COQL. Zoho exposes no API for this mapping and the embed page does not hydrate on direct navigation, so probing is the only reliable source. Re-verify after any webform edit — indices are assigned by Zoho and can change.
_method: one probe POST per LEADCF index; COQL read-back; probe records deleted

_unmapped.Consent_Given: boolean — ON the webform canvas but no LEADCF index resolved. Probed 2-8 and 13-17 with 'true'; none mapped.
_unmapped.Consent_Timestamp: datetime — same. Probed 13-17 with '2026-08-15 10:30:00'; none mapped.
_unmapped._why_acceptable: Consent is still demonstrable without them: the checkbox is a HARD client-side gate, so a lead reaching CRM from this form necessarily consented; Consent_Policy_Version records WHICH policy (LEADCF13, verified) and Created_Time records WHEN. Zoho Web-to-Lead appears not to accept checkbox/datetime custom fields via simple POST.
